malay-sultanliklari.alinti: P'ong-fong is generally identified with Paliang on tlie E. coast of the Malay Peninsula
malay-sultanliklari.kaynak: Chau Ju-kua, Chu-fan-chi (1225), Hirth & Rockhill 1911 (archive.org chaujukuahiswork00chao)
malay-sultanliklari.not: Chau Ju-kua 1225: P'ong-fong San-fo-ts'i (Srivijaya) bagimlilari listesinde ("The following are all dependencies (of this country) Pong-fOng"); Hirth notundaki "Paliang" OCR, Pahang demek (Pelliot BEFEO IV,344). 1280 sahibi COK ADAYLI: atlas srivijaya t=1275; Nagarakretagama 42:2 (1365, Kertanagara Pamalayu 1275 sonrasi) "pahan" Singhasari ye boyun egdi; ikisi de 1280 gunu vermez; CELISKI/belirsiz. Pekan sehir adi degil Pahang olke adi (bolge).
